t:
Subchapter II of chapter 99 is amended by inserting in numerical sequence the following new heading:











“9902.40.11Acrylic staple fibers (polyacrylonitrile staple) containing 85 percent or more by weight of acrylonitrile units and 2 percent or more but not over 3 percent of water, not pigmented (ecru), crimped, with an average decitex of 1.3 (plus or minus 10 percent) and fiber length of 40 mm (plus or minus 10 percent) (provided for in subheading 5503.30.00)FreeNo changeNo changeOn or before 12/31/2012”.

fable.w: This section only amends the Harmonized Tariff Schedule to add a temporary duty suspension for a specific acrylic staple fiber. It contains no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting participation reading here; Congress directly sets the tariff treatment itself.

qwen_block.w: This section is a technical amendment to the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, adding a specific product classification and duty rate. It does not contain any language requiring or recommending consultation with outside parties, public hearings, comment periods, or advisory committees. The text is purely substantive, defining a tariff entry, rather than procedural regarding public participation.
qwen_block.s: Subchapter II of chapter 99 is amended by inserting in numerical sequence the following new heading: “9902.40.11Acrylic staple fibers (polyacrylonitrile staple) containing 85 percent or more by weight of acrylonitrile units and 2 percent or more but not over 3 percent of water, not pigmented (ecru), crimped, with an average decitex of 1.3 (plus or minus 10 percent) and fiber length of 40 mm (plus or minus 10 percent) (provided for in subheading 5503.30.00)FreeNo changeNo changeOn or before 12/31/2012”.
qwen_block.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because this text amends a tariff schedule, it implicitly involves public participation through the rulemaking process that typically accompanies such changes. However, the text itself is purely a technical amendment to a classification code and duty rate. It does not mention any consultation, hearing, comment period, or advisory body. It is a substantive change to the law, not a procedural requirement for participation.

opus.w: This section only adds a tariff heading that suspends duties on a specific acrylic fiber product until 12/31/2012. It gives no role to states, the public, experts or anyone else outside the federal government, and it grants no rulemaking authority. The word "amended" is just how a law is changed; it is not a process that involves outside parties.
